<details align="center">
<summary><b>↕︎ What each project actually does</b></summary>
<br/>

| Project | The one-line version | Built with |
|---|---|---|
| **[SentinelGraph](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/sentinelgraph)** | Fraud detection over a graph — rings, mule funnels, shared-device fraud farms, each flag backed by clickable evidence | CognoDB · FastAPI · React |
| **[RouteOS](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/RouteOS-Intelligent-Logistics-Fleet-Optimization-Platform)** | Capacity- and time-window-aware multi-vehicle routing, with a live map and re-optimisation when traffic breaks the plan | Python · FastAPI · React + TS · PostGIS |
| **[Order Execution Engine](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/Order-Execution-Engine)** | Routes market orders across Solana DEXs, with queued execution and realtime fills over WebSocket | TypeScript · Fastify · BullMQ · Redis |
| **[Meeting Intelligence](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/meeting-intelligence-assistant)** | Recordings → transcripts, summaries and action items, searchable semantically rather than by keyword | Whisper · pgvector · FastAPI |
| **[DAG Workflow Designer](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/dag-workflow-designer)** | Drag-and-drop pipeline builder that validates the graph is actually a DAG before you run it | React Flow · Zustand · FastAPI |
| **[Distributed KV Store](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/Distributed-Key-Value-Database-in-C-)** | In-memory key-value database written from scratch — WAL, snapshots, replication, custom query parser | C++ · TCP sockets |
| **[Online Coding Judge](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/online-coding-judge)** | Submit, sandbox, evaluate against test cases, run contests, rank a leaderboard | FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Docker |
| **[URL Shortener](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/url-shortener)** | Base62 short links with Redis-cached redirects, click analytics and expiry | FastAPI · PostgreSQL · Redis |
| **[Galactic Cargo](https://github.com/dhanoliya-ji/Galactic-Cargo-Management-System)** | Warehouse allocation on AVL trees — fast insert, delete, search and capacity updates | Python · OOP · AVL trees |

</details>
